settings.heading: Track Your Order
settings.body: Every order ships from our UK warehouse, and you'll get a shipping confirmation email with a tracking link the moment it's on its way. If you can't find it, here's how to get to it.

settings.heading: Normal timings
settings.body:
Orders placed on a working day are picked and dispatched the next working day. Once your parcel is with the carrier it typically arrives within 1-3 working days.

Tracking can take a few hours to start showing movement after you receive the email - that's the carrier scanning it into their network, not a problem with your parcel.

settings.heading: If something doesn't look right
settings.body: Most tracking worries fall into one of these three, and two of them fix themselves.

settings.heading: No confirmation email
settings.body: Check your spam and promotions folders first, and confirm you're looking at the address you used at checkout. If it's genuinely missing, message us with your name and order date and we'll resend it.

settings.heading: Tracking hasn't updated
settings.body: Give it 24 hours. Carriers sometimes scan a parcel only at the sorting hub rather than on collection, so tracking can look frozen while the parcel is moving perfectly normally.

settings.heading: Marked delivered, nothing arrived
settings.body: Check with neighbours and any safe place you've nominated with the carrier. If it's still missing after 24 hours, contact us with your order number and we'll open an investigation with the carrier.

settings.heading: Send us your order number and we'll look it up
settings.body: Quickest route is WhatsApp - send the order number and we'll check it against the carrier for you.
